rules.description: Strictly enforce historical deletion average threshold of 0.1%
Verifies that livestock inventory StatVars have current-year observations (>= 2026) and all other survey StatVars are within allowable lag (>= 2025)

params.condition: CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_FarmInventory_CattleAndCalves', 'Count_FarmInventory_BeefCows', 'Count_FarmInventory_MilkCows', 'Count_FarmInventory_SheepAndLambs') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2026 ELSE CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2025 END
